{"code":"def transform(grid):
    out=[row[:] for row in grid]
    pts=[(r,c) for r,row in enumerate(grid) for c,v in enumerate(row) if v==2]
    if len(pts)<2: return out
    (r1,c1),(r2,c2)=pts[:2]
    ra,rb=sorted((r1,r2)); ca,cb=sorted((c1,c2))
    for r in range(len(grid)):
        for c in range(len(grid[0])):
            if r in (ra,rb) or c in (ca,cb): out[r][c]=2
            elif ra<r<rb and ca<c<cb: out[r][c]=1
    return out"}
